name: 33312 · Ft Lauderdale, FL
findings: ZIP 33312 (Ft Lauderdale) has 258 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 67 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33312 (Ft Lauderdale) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 30 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 58% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
